newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to vet P&O/Nedlloyd deal - Van Miert.
newsitem.headline: EU to vet P&O/Nedlloyd deal - Van Miert.

text.p: European Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert said on Monday that the Commission would examine the merger of the container shipping businesses of P&O and Nedlloyd.

But he said it was too early to say whether the Commission would use the deal as leverage to force long-sought changes to the Trans-Atlantic Conference Agreement (TACA), a liner shipping agreement for the transport of containers between the EU and North America. P&O and Nedlloyd are both members of TACA.

"(The merger) is going to be looked into," Van Miert told reporters in reply to questions. He added that the Commission needed more information on the case, hinting discussions were already under way even before the case was formally submitted for clearance.
Van Miert was speaking on the sidelines of a seminar on competition policy organised by think-tank Centre for European Policy Studies.

Van Miert has been trying for years to abolish TACA provisions allowing for its members to agree on prices, especially on the land transport of containers to and from ports. Alternatively, the TACA members could improve their services to better fit shippers interests, for example in terms of container fleet management.
The deal between P&O and Nedlloyd was announced earlier this month. --Brussels newsroom 322 2876841
